patch_list: Blocks all AdMob and Flutter Google Mobile Ads formats, hides the 'Deals' tab and campaign promos, disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and Facebook SDK auto-tracking, and removes Advertising ID permissions.
Restores the original certificate SHA-1 so Firebase Auth (Google login) and push notifications keep working after the APK is re-signed.
